tools.notes: Internally called 'The Ship'. Verified by reading the repo. studio/registry.js is the authoritative module shelf and this dashboard now syncs from it rather than keeping a second copy. Architecture is documented in MODULES.md, which is unusually thorough — it covers the module contract, the FTVStore adapter, seeding and shape repair, interconnect deduping, printing, CSV safety, accessibility and 31 automated checks. Phase 2 (a Cloudflare Worker backend) is planned but not built: all client data currently lives in one browser's localStorage, and studio/data.html is the only way out of it.

modules.name: Website

modules.name: CRM · Lead Book
modules.description: Capture leads from every form; track Contacted → Working → Closed, with follow-up dates that flag cold leads.

modules.name: Invoicing
modules.description: Bill clients, print a branded PDF, track paid/unpaid, log paid invoices as income.

modules.name: Client Gallery
modules.description: Access-code photo albums — clients select photos, download them, and order prints that raise an invoice.

modules.name: Accounting-light
modules.description: Income, expenses & HST — plus a printable HST return and P&L by category.

modules.name: Budget
modules.description: Plan a monthly budget by category and track spend against it — actuals pulled from Accounting.

modules.name: Full BrokerFlow
modules.description: Brokerage hub — live KPIs from your own data, a commission calculator that posts to Accounting, listings + Lighthouse screens.

modules.name: Showings

modules.name: Tournaments Builder
modules.description: Single-elim brackets or a round-robin league with a live standings table, registration & a public view.

modules.name: Staff Management
modules.description: Employees, schedules, time-off, payroll & a staff portal.

modules.name: Suppliers & Inventory
modules.description: Supplier catalogue, reorder points, purchase orders & showcase-to-site — stock spend lands in Accounting.

modules.name: Shop CMS
modules.description: Menu, prices, photos, daily specials & a promotion banner — plus a printable menu board.

modules.name: Bookings
modules.description: Services, an appointment form & a schedule — bookings become leads, and a completed booking becomes an invoice.

modules.name: Club Management
modules.description: Registration, scheduling, officials, practice planning and club accounting.

modules.name: Finance Command Centre
modules.description: Personal and business finance tracking, commissions and trust accounting.

modules.name: PEI Rental Intelligence
